content: Studies such as CREDENCE have demonstrated that canagliflozin significantly reduces the progression of chronic kidney disease (CKD) in patients with type 2 diabetes and also lowers the risk of cardiovascular events, including heart failure and major adverse cardiovascular events. Similarly, findings from the DAPA-CKD trial have shown that dapagliflozin is effective in slowing the progression of CKD, regardless of the presence of diabetes, and provides substantial cardiovascular protection by reducing the incidence of heart failure hospitalizations and cardiovascular mortality. These trials underscore the dual benefits of these SGLT2 inhibitors in managing both renal and cardiovascular outcomes in at-risk populations.
